definition: ἱστορέω, -ῶ (ἵστωρ, one learned or skilled in) [in LXX: 1Es.1:33 Est.1:42 * ;] __1. with accusative of thing(s), to inquire into, learn by inquiry.  __2. C. accusative of person(s), to inquire of or about.  __3. to narrate, record.  __4. In late writers, to visit, become acquainted with: Gal.1:18 (see Ellic., in l, and cf. MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)
